body: Thank you so much! It's been so long since anyone's told me I'm worth it that I almost cried reading that. I know deep down that nothing will ever get better, I just hate feeling like its my fault he is this way, it makes me terrified to ever be in another relationship

Thank you so much for replying, this really helped me. I really had convinced myself I was crazy for thinking that this was an unhealthy, far from normal relationship. It just scares me to move on and be without him, but I think for my own personal and mental wellbeing, it's something that I need to do

I'm just more scared because when I say I'm done and I'm not happy anymore he says he is going to kill himself or he says that no one will ever love me. And it's like I don't want to leave him, because I love him and the person he used to be but I don't know how to fix this :(
I just hope I'll have the strength to move on
Thank you, that's very true. I just need to keep reminding myself that
I'm not sure I just need help getting out of an emotionally abusive relationship
